name: i2s_std
description: i2s_std, unmodified, duplex: one controller's TX and RX share BCLK and WS (SIG_LOOPBACK); MSB format, 32-bit stereo at 16 kHz from the PLL's 160 MHz, so BCLK is 16000 x 64 = 1.024 MHz and WS 16 kHz. The write task sends a 2048-byte buffer of 12 34 56 78 9a bc de f0 repeated; the read task, through IO4 where DOUT and DIN meet, reads it back and prints its first eight bytes, as the example's README shows.
